scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace @audit-scanner/api run build && npm --workspace @audit-scanner/worker run build && npm --workspace @audit-scanner/web run build
scripts.build:api:render: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages && npm --workspace @audit-scanner/api run build
scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace @audit-scanner/shared run build && npm --workspace @audit-scanner/database run build && npm --workspace @audit-scanner/scanner-core run build && npm --workspace @audit-scanner/analysis-ir run build
scripts.build:web:vercel: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace @audit-scanner/web run build
scripts.docker:local:scanners:build: docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml exec worker npm run docker:scanners:build
scripts.docker:local:scanners:smoke: docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml exec worker npm run docker:scanners:smoke
scripts.docker:scanners:build: npm run docker:scanners:build:base && docker compose -f docker-compose.scanners.yml --profile scanner-images build scanner-slither scanner-mythril scanner-semgrep scanner-foundry
scripts.docker:scanners:build:base: docker compose -f docker-compose.scanners.yml --profile scanner-images build scanner-base
scripts.docker:scanners:smoke: docker compose -f docker-compose.scanners.yml --profile scanner-smoke run --rm scanner-slither && docker compose -f docker-compose.scanners.yml --profile scanner-smoke run --rm scanner-mythril && docker compose -f docker-compose.scanners.yml --profile scanner-smoke run --rm scanner-semgrep && docker compose -f docker-compose.scanners.yml --profile scanner-smoke run --rm scanner-foundry
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:api && npm run test:worker && npm run test:scanner && npm run test:prisma && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:ci: npm run db:generate && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:api && npm run test:worker && npm run test:scanner && npm run test:prisma && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:security
scripts.test:infra:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace @audit-scanner/api run typecheck && npm --workspace @audit-scanner/web run typecheck && npm --workspace @audit-scanner/worker run typecheck && npm --workspace @audit-scanner/worker run typecheck:sandbox && npm --workspace @audit-scanner/database run typecheck && npm --workspace @audit-scanner/scanner-core run typecheck && npm --workspace @audit-scanner/analysis-ir run typecheck && npm --workspace @audit-scanner/shared run typecheck
